definition.title: Relational decision authority gate for MV7038-F03-equality-chain
definition.hypothesis: Hold real allocation, identity, participant, legal, cultural and production decisions.
definition.null_or_failure_condition: Mismatch with the independently specified oracle; malformed or over-bound inputs accepted; result promotion; input mutation; lost negative evidence.
definition.acceptance: No synthetic certificate supplies consent, competent authority or Stage 20 approval.
definition.falsifier: A returned value differs from the oracle or the frozen fixture solution count; any such disagreement stops the affected tranche.
definition.source_bounded_novelty_scope: Exact titles and operation names compared only with the immediate Neris 300-row source.
definition.rollback: Retain the frozen source and failed observation; add only an attributable narrow correction.

relational_boundary: Finite synthetic same-owner evidence only; no independent reproduction, empirical, production, identity, consciousness, professional, legal, cultural, Maori-authority or Stage 20 promotion.
